title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644
source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne;Soundboard (shnid:95638), Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k),Transfer Info:Dat (Sony D8) -> VX Pocket 440 -> Sharp MV10 -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 ->FLAC -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC; amd Audience (shnid:113826), AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a hot 1982 show highlighted by standout Mexicali Blues, Peggy‑O, Bird Song and many other gems.
ai_review.review: The matrix source is praised as crystal‑clear and the best sounding version of this concert, delivering a vivid listening experience. Reviewers rave about the band’s fire, citing Mexicali Blues, Peggy‑O, Bird Song, Estimated Prophet, Stella Blue, Iko Iko and Man Smart as high points throughout both sets.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are highly positive (4‑5 stars) and consistently praise both the musical performance and the matrix recording quality, indicating an overall excellent show with an excellent source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as very nice, great, and the best they have heard of this show – a clear, well‑balanced matrix mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set openings with Iko Iko and Man Smart are noted as fresh, while the second set delivers a strong flow with Peggy-O, Bird Song and other highlights, keeping energy high throughout.
